title: ForceZero on all key material: key bytes in ctx structs and init_op all zeroed before free
description: Raw AES keys (Crypto2DevAesCtx), HMAC keys (Crypto2DevHmacCtx), and the on-stack crypto2dev_init_op (which contains the inline key) are all wiped with ForceZero before being freed or returned from functions. ForceZero is a volatile write that cannot be optimized away by the compiler. A contributor might replace with XMEMSET arguing they are equivalent. They are not: XMEMSET on a variable about to go out of scope can be elided by an optimizing compiler. ForceZero is the correct choice for secret material.
